entities.name: UniProt Q8H185
observations: Arabidopsis thaliana acireductone dioxygenase 4; supplied 187-aa sequence exactly matches the reviewed UniProt reference.

Annotated as a metal-dependent acireductone dioxygenase: Fe-bound activity yields formate and 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate (methionine precursor); Ni-bound activity yields methylthiopropionate, CO, and formate.
Annotated role in L-methionine metabolism and methionine salvage pathway; reported localization includes cytoplasm/cytosol and nucleus, with plasma-membrane GO annotation also present.

entities.name: Methionine salvage
observations: UniProt annotation places acireductone dioxygenase at step 5/6 of L-methionine biosynthesis via the salvage pathway; Fe-bound reaction produces the alpha-ketoacid precursor of methionine.
